datasets.name: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds
variables_present: non-sexual somatic morphology: eleven continuous traits, raw individual measurements (90020 individuals, 11009 species)
variables_missing: no ornament or plumage variables stated
sex coding of individuals not stated in the description
datasets.evidence: Figshare API description and file list as in other AVONET entries; license CC BY 4.0.

datasets.name: Data and codes from: Flight hampers the evolution of weapons in birds (species_spur_data.csv)

datasets.evidence: File list includes species_spur_data.csv (1565132 bytes) and Jetz_trees.nex; license CC0-1.0.

datasets.name: BirdTree
variables_present: dated bird phylogeny distributions for downloads
datasets.evidence: Downloads page describes four tree distributions of 10K trees each in zip archives.

datasets.name: Macaulay Library
variables_missing: no measurement table; ornament size would have to be extracted from media
datasets.evidence: Landing page returned 200 (132622 bytes); no dataset or measurement endpoint was fetched.

datasets.name: MorphoSource
variables_present: 3D media of vertebrate specimens (CT, surface scans)
variables_missing: no measurements; paired/homologous structures would have to be landmarked from the meshes
datasets.evidence: API q=Cervidae returned an empty media list; q=Mammalia returned total_count 5 with per_page=1 (first record: Bettongia ogilbyi sylvatica holotype skull, Photogrammetry). Public API search returned few records for these terms.

datasets.name: Open Tree of Life synthetic tree and taxonomy (OTT 3.7)
variables_present: synthetic species-level topology of all life (taxonomy-grafted)
taxonomy for genus membership of tips
variables_missing: synthetic tree is a supertree without branch lengths in a form suited to rates; no dated, rate-ready tree
datasets.evidence: tree_of_life/about returned num_tips 2385875, num_source_trees 2064, num_source_studies 1931, date_created 2025-12-20; taxonomy/about returned version ott3.7draft3.

datasets.name: VertLife phylogeny subsets

datasets.name: Dryad (general portal)

checked.method: GET https://datadryad.org/ (landing) and search API (see search_log)

variables_missing: a portal, not a dataset; individual Dryad datasets are listed separately where relevant

search_log.query: plumage ornament tail length species comparative dimorphism sex-specific measurements
secondary sexual traits coefficient of variation versus non-sexual traits
sexually selected traits variation interspecific divergence plumage tail length (dataset type)

summary: No repository table pairs measurements of secondary sexual characters with matched non-sexual traits and within-species variance across congeneric species; AVONET gives the non-sexual bird baseline and one Dryad deposit gives bird spurs, but the Dale/Cooney plumage compilations and the CV meta-analyses named by an assessor were not found as datasets by any search.
next_step: Compile sex-specific ornament and body measurements for one dense clade (galliforms or lizards, as the obstacles suggest) and pre-register the CV and divergence comparison, using AVONET as the non-sexual reference.
obstacles_confirmed: Global morphology tables are mostly unsexed and omit plumage and other ornaments.
Sex-specific compilations are dense for a few groups, such as galliforms and lizards, and sparse elsewhere.
